definition.simple: How quickly something speeds up, slows down, or changes direction.
definition.academic: The rate of change of velocity of an object with respect to time.

examples: A car pressing the gas pedal to go from 0 to 60 km/h.

common_misconceptions: Thinking acceleration only means speeding up (ignoring changing direction or slowing down).
ai_context.tutor_hint: Ask: 'If a car is moving at a constant speed in a circle, is it accelerating?' (Answer: Yes, because direction changes).
